question: What was the reign of Qutubuddin Aybak?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1206-1210**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Qutubuddin Aybak** was the founder of the **Slave Dynasty**, also known as the **Mamluk Dynasty**, and he reigned as the first independent **Sultan of Delhi** from **1206** to **1210**.
